note: Honest cut (27 Oct, v3): banner flow first, sketch as extension, then the first-attempt result on four new banners including what failed. One live capture on a local build of the final code with the same live models: capture/full.mjs --url http://127.0.0.1:8780.

beats.text: Every campaign ships the same ad in a dozen shapes and languages, and someone rebuilds each one by hand.

beats.onScreen: Drop in a banner. Check what it found.
beats.text: I drop in a banner. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL reads it into six typed layers. Deterministic image analysis then fits every box to the real pixels and paints neighbouring ink out of each crop. Nothing is trusted until I confirm it.
beats.say: I drop in a banner. Nemotron three point five Super V L reads it into six typed layers. Deterministic image analysis then fits every box to the real pixels and paints neighbouring ink out of each crop. Nothing is trusted until I confirm it.

beats.text: A long German headline will not fit. A blind tool would squeeze it. This one renders both layouts on a real graphics engine, measures them, and Nemotron 3 Super words the question.
beats.say: A long German headline will not fit. A blind tool would squeeze it. This one renders both layouts on a real graphics engine, measures them, and Nemotron three Super words the question.

beats.text: I pick split. An independent verifier, separate code from the renderer, re-measures fifteen structural checks: copy, link, logo, proportions, safe areas, sizes, overlaps.

Now I try to break it: delete the product, change a price digit, push the headline off the card. The checker catches each one, and the receipt ties my words to the file by SHA-256, verifiable offline.
beats.say: Now I try to break it: delete the product, change a price digit, push the headline off the card. The checker catches each one, and the receipt ties my words to the file by sha two fifty six, verifiable offline.

beats.onScreen: No banner yet? A sketch and your product page.
beats.text: No banner yet? Start from a rough sketch and a product page. Nemotron reads the wireframe, and Tavily extracts the page. This sample sketch is one we generated.

beats.onScreen: Facts from your page, with their quotes
beats.text: Nemotron 3 Super lifts facts from the page, each with its source quote, and a quote that is not on the page is rejected. Headline drafts are checked for numbers, currency, claim words and glyphs, and every draft is for me to approve.
beats.say: Nemotron three Super lifts facts from the page, each with its source quote, and a quote that is not on the page is rejected. Headline drafts are checked for numbers, currency, claim words and glyphs, and every draft is for me to approve.

beats.onScreen: Your own pictures, built as editable layers
beats.text: I add my own logo and product picture, and build. The banner is rebuilt as editable layers on Konva and Fabric, and adapted to a story card.

beats.onScreen: Checked against your page. You approve the words.
beats.text: A page check looks for the price among the amounts on the page, and this panel says where every part came from: the layout from the sketch, the words from the page, the pictures from me.

beats.onScreen: Held-out test: 17 new banners, first pass
beats.text: On seventeen new banners nobody tuned on: every word and part read exactly on the twelve flat ones, all five photos refused before a model call, four of twelve clean cards on the first pass. We publish what failed.
It says what it cannot do: flat backgrounds only, one font, sixteen by nine, no generated pictures, and it can stop on a tiny or oddly spaced logo.
Two graphics engines, an independent verifier, a hash-checked receipt, eighteen hundred tests, honest numbers. Open Apprentice.
